snippet.title: SAMSON Gameplay Trailer - Future Games Show Spring Showcase 2026
snippet.description:
Samson is the next game from the creator of Just Cause — a gritty momentum-based brawler where you fight your way through crushing debt. hour by hour. New gameplay was revealed during the Future Games Show Spring Showcase ahead of the game's April 8 release on PC.

Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3634520/Samson/

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS

Future Publishing uses the Epidemic Sound Library, Getty Image Library, Shutterstock Image Library, Motion Array and Adobe Creative Cloud
